title: Reassigning a staff member's role updates the row with no success message (billing note in the window)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Staff page changing a user's role via Edit Staff Member.
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Staff Member for a user.
  2. Choose a new Role and click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
The Edit Staff Member window shows the Role dropdown with a note beneath it that role changes may impact billing.

On Save & Close the window closes and the Staff row shows the new role.

No success message appears for the reassignment (unlike creating or updating a role, which show 'Role created/updated successfully.').
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live Staff page); billing note not re-captured this pass
evidence: No-toast-on-reassign + billing note need live Staff page (EditStaffMember chunk not fetched).
